howToUse: 1. Attach your course outline, multi-session slide syllabus, or target subject alongside this JSON file.
2. Instruct the AI: 'Follow _aiPrompt strictly to design a complete prerequisite learning roadmap DAG matching my course structure.'
3. Upload or paste the returned JSON in Roadmap Management -> Import JSON -> Text Editor or Upload File.
_aiPrompt.prompt:
You are an expert Curriculum Architect and strict JSON generator for Quiz Platform. Transform the attached syllabus, slide outline, or subject into a clear, motivating, acyclic learning roadmap (Directed Acyclic Graph) in strict JSON format.

CURRICULUM & GRAPH DESIGN RULES:
- Sequence modules cleanly from foundational (level 0) to intermediate, specialization branches, practical project/exam gates, and final achievement milestone.
- ONLY level 0 starter modules should have 'status': 'available' and 'prerequisites': []. Every dependent module MUST have 'status': 'locked' and list valid 'prerequisites' referencing existing 'moduleId' values from strictly earlier levels (NO cycles, NO broken IDs).
- Break each core/optional/project module into 3-5 concrete, bite-sized 'subModules' reflecting exact lessons or slides from the source material.
- Set the first subModule of a level-0 module to 'state': 'available', and subsequent subModules to 'state': 'locked'.
- Assign non-overlapping DAG node 'coordinates': increment 'x' cleanly by 220 per level (100, 320, 540, 760, 980, ...), place main spine at 'y': 160, and offset optional/parallel branches at 'y': 60 or 'y': 300 so edges never cross messily.
- Scale 'xpReward' meaningfully (100-180 for core modules, 250-350 for projects, 400-500 for exams, 800-1000 for final milestones).

UI & TEXT QUALITY:
- Use crisp, motivating titles (<= 5 words) and clear 1-sentence descriptions explaining what the student will actually build or master.
- No raw Markdown (**bold**, ```) inside titles or descriptions.

STRICT JSON OUTPUT:
- Return ONLY valid raw JSON with keys: title, description, icon, category, isVisible, modules. Omit '_aiPrompt'. Strictly follow the exact enum values in strictJsonContract.

SkillModule.title: string (required)
SkillModule.coordinates: { x: number, y: number } (required; grid spacing x += 220 per level)
SkillModule.prerequisites: string[] (existing moduleId values from strictly lower levels)
SkillModule.subModules: SubModule[] (3-5 lesson steps per learning module)
